description: This file defines a class OrderByRequestHandler that processes query parameters related to ordering results, such as column and direction, validating them and generating an SQL fragment.

classes.name: OrderByRequestHandler
classes.description: Handles parsing and validation of orderBy query parameters, providing SQL fragment for use in database queries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with parameters, applying defaults and validations for order column and direction.

methods.name: toSql
methods.description: Returns the SQL string representing the ordering clause based on provided parameters.
